ValidationRule.description: VR to make sure that Correct Customer Reference Number is provided when Incorrect Customer Reference Number is selected as the Dispute Reason
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = "BPAY_Dispute", ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Incorrect Customer Reference Number") && ISBLANK(Correct_Customer_Reference_Number__c), FALSE)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide Correct Customer Reference Number.
